title: My Thrill Club is not thrilling AT ALL!
text:
*Second Review: February 3rd, 2021*
Okay....so, I recently received the second box from My Thrill Club. I was a bit apprehensive when opening it because the first box I received was pretty much a dud.
Well....... same goes for this one!!!. It was LAME!
I have never heard of the 2 hardback books I received. Plus, one of the books was from a series. They didn’t send me the first book in the series though.... Oh, no no no..... they sent me the 2nd book..... a flippin’ sequel!?!?! A sequel in a book series I’ve never even heard of!
I have a book account on Instagram, and so, I went and asked other readers who have subscribed or purchased a box from My Thrill Club and what their thoughts were on the boxes they received. Nearly all of the readers that I asked had the same feelings that had: we were unimpressed with My Thrill Club.
This was a gift from my lovely sister-in-law. It was an AWESOME idea for a gift, I just wish her money was wasted on a company like My Thrill Club.
I only have 1 more box coming my way, so, I’ll be writing an update after it arrives.

*First Review: December 30th, 2020*
My awesome sis-in-law got me a 3 month Subscription for Christmas and I was super excited about it. Well....I just received my first My Thrill Club box, and so far, I’m not that impressed. I’ve subscribed to quite a few Bookish Box subscriptions before and My Thrill Club is my least favorite. Like the website described, I received two hardback books, Hunger & Vampire stories. Thankfully, I’m happy about one of the books I received...even though I’ve read it before. I really liked the book but I had borrowed it from the library.... so now I have my own copy to add to my book collection. Other than the two hardbacks, the website also described that there would be an ebook, or a code to a selection of ebooks? I got no code. Which, after reading several other reviews, I’m not the only one missing the part of the subscription that was described. Bummer.
Will I be recommending this box to friends....I don’t know. We’ll see how it goes after I receive the next two boxes.
Huge thanks to my sister-in-law for the thoughtful gift. She did an awesome job...too bad My Thrill Club did not.
